title: Frames
description: Fleet telemetry from the frame heartbeat payloads in Loki, filterable per frame and firmware.

list.name: frame
list.label: Frame
list.description: Frame serial number, labelled onto the heartbeat line by Promtail.

list.name: search
list.label: Search
list.description: Substring filter for the raw heartbeat payloads panel.

panels.title: Fleet

targets.expr: last_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} | regexp `log - b'(?P<payload>\{.*\})'$` | line_format `{{.payload}}` | json | label_format frame_status=`{{ if or (ne .health_state "ok") (eq .dashboard_running "false") (eq .display_running "false") (eq .update_running "false") (eq .websocket_running "false") }}2{{ else if or (gt (float64 .cpu_temp_celsius) 70.0) (gt (divf (subf (float64 .ram_total_bytes) (float64 .ram_available_bytes)) (float64 .ram_total_bytes)) 0.9) (gt (subf 1.0 (divf (float64 .storage_data_free_bytes) (float64 .storage_data_total_bytes))) 0.9) }}1{{ else }}0{{ end }}` | unwrap frame_status [$__range]) by (serial_number)

panels.description: One hexagon per frame. Green: healthy. Yellow: CPU temp, RAM or disk over threshold. Red: health_state not ok, or a service down.

targets.expr: avg(last_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} | regexp `log - b'(?P<payload>\{.*\})'$` | line_format `{{.payload}}` | json | unwrap cpu_usage_percent [$__range]) by (serial_number))

avg(last_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} | regexp `log - b'(?P<payload>\{.*\})'$` | line_format `{{.payload}}` | json | label_format ram_used_percent=`{{ mulf (divf (subf (float64 .ram_total_bytes) (float64 .ram_available_bytes)) (float64 .ram_total_bytes)) 100 }}` | unwrap ram_used_percent [$__range]) by (serial_number))

avg(last_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} | regexp `log - b'(?P<payload>\{.*\})'$` | line_format `{{.payload}}` | json | unwrap cpu_temp_celsius [$__range]) by (serial_number))

panels.title: Frames reporting

targets.expr: count(count by (serial_number) (count_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} [$__range])))

panels.description: Distinct frames that sent telemetry in the range. Legacy firmware sends no serial and is counted separately below.

panels.title: Unhealthy

targets.expr: count(count by (serial_number) (count_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} | regexp `log - b'(?P<payload>\{.*\})'$` | line_format `{{.payload}}` | json | health_state != "ok" [$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.description: Frames that reported health_state other than ok at any point in the range.

panels.title: Service down

targets.expr: sum(last_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} | regexp `log - b'(?P<payload>\{.*\})'$` | line_format `{{.payload}}` | json | label_format service_down=`{{ if or (eq .dashboard_running "false") (eq .display_running "false") (eq .update_running "false") (eq .websocket_running "false") }}1{{ else }}0{{ end }}` | unwrap service_down [$__range]) by (serial_number)) or vector(0)

panels.description: Frames whose last heartbeat reported dashboard, display, update or websocket not running.

panels.title: Reboots in range

targets.expr: sum(max_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} | regexp `log - b'(?P<payload>\{.*\})'$` | line_format `{{.payload}}` | json | unwrap boot_count [$__range]) by (serial_number) - min_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} | regexp `log - b'(?P<payload>\{.*\})'$` | line_format `{{.payload}}` | json | unwrap boot_count [$__range]) by (serial_number))

panels.description: Fleet-wide boot_count increase over the range.

targets.expr: last_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} | regexp `log - b'(?P<payload>\{.*\})'$` | line_format `{{.payload}}` | json | label_format healthy=`{{ if eq .health_state "ok" }}1{{ else }}0{{ end }}` | unwrap healthy [$__auto]) by (serial_number)

panels.title: Services

targets.expr: min_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} | regexp `log - b'(?P<payload>\{.*\})'$` | line_format `{{.payload}}` | json | label_format s=`{{ if eq .dashboard_running "true" }}1{{ else }}0{{ end }}` | unwrap s [$__auto]) by (serial_number)

min_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} | regexp `log - b'(?P<payload>\{.*\})'$` | line_format `{{.payload}}` | json | label_format s=`{{ if eq .display_running "true" }}1{{ else }}0{{ end }}` | unwrap s [$__auto]) by (serial_number)

min_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} | regexp `log - b'(?P<payload>\{.*\})'$` | line_format `{{.payload}}` | json | label_format s=`{{ if eq .update_running "true" }}1{{ else }}0{{ end }}` | unwrap s [$__auto]) by (serial_number)

min_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} | regexp `log - b'(?P<payload>\{.*\})'$` | line_format `{{.payload}}` | json | label_format s=`{{ if eq .websocket_running "true" }}1{{ else }}0{{ end }}` | unwrap s [$__auto]) by (serial_number)

panels.description: One lane per frame and service. A red band is a service the frame reported as not running.

panels.title: Heartbeats received

targets.expr: sum by (serial_number) (count_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} [$__auto]))

panels.description: Heartbeats per interval. A gap is a frame that went silent.

panels.description: One row per frame, from its most recent heartbeat in the range.

panels.title: Legacy frames

targets.expr: count(count by (frame_ip) (count_over_time({job="backend", frame_ip=~".+", serial_number=""} [$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.description: Frames on firmware that posts only its IP and version. They cannot appear in any panel above.

panels.title: Legacy frames seen

targets.expr: sum by (frame_ip, frame_version) (count_over_time({job="backend", frame_ip=~".+", serial_number=""} [$__range]))

panels.description: Keyed by IP, the only identifier legacy firmware sends. A DHCP change reads as a new row.

panels.title: Legacy heartbeats

targets.expr: sum by (frame_ip) (count_over_time({job="backend", frame_ip=~".+", serial_number=""} [$__auto]))

panels.description: Legacy firmware heartbeats every 15 minutes, so expect sparse columns.

panels.title: Heartbeat payloads

targets.expr: {job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} |= "$search" | regexp `log - b'(?P<payload>\{.*\})'$` | line_format `{{.payload}}`

panels.description: The raw telemetry JSON each frame posted. Use Search to grep it.
